page.notes: The page is printed sideways: the scan is turned a quarter turn, so the title and the outline read from bottom to top. The brace groups are read as a tree, with the levels taken from the drawing; the level numbers are my reading of the brackets. "Stoicorum m. cap.7." is only partly visible at the lower edge, so its last letters may be incomplete. The upper edge of this part is cut, so the box above "Omnium fermè, cap.8." is only partly visible and is not transcribed. The levels of the boxes are read from the brace positions in the drawing and are approximate for the upper boxes, which are small and rotated. "Technologiæ" is a rotated word; the letters are read as printed. Its ligature and accents are uncertain and are not marked, because the rotated print is clear enough to read. The scan is rotated 90 degrees, so the text runs sideways. Everything here is marginal synopsis; there is no running text block on this part. The bracketed group is a synopsis: one label, "Sententia authoris", with two entries. The left-edge fragment "funt" is uncertain and may belong to a word cut off elsewhere on the page.
